big_case.notes: A recurring criminal-procedure question (what prejudice means under Remmer and Olano once a jury has seen extra-record material) with a genuine, long-percolating split, on a murder-for-hire record that drew national press. Doctrinally consequential for trial courts if taken, but not a structural or headline constitutional dispute; the government waived, no Justice called for a response, and the denial carried no separate writing, so the realized footprint is small. Moderate-low stakes.
